title: InvadedQueueShortener
description: Shortens InvadedLands queue messages in chat for 1.21+
body:
# InvadedLands Queue Shortener

**Description:**
Shortens InvadedLands queue messages in chat for 1.21+
InvadedLands queue messages takes a lot of space in chat because of server rank part and leave queue so I decide why not keep only the useful information we want.
InvadedLands server ip is **invadedlands.net**
This mod just removes the non useful information by trimming the big text to only our queue position and on what queue.

**Before Installing.**

![Before Mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/23cdac2441857be089b50159e7664d59a37ff61b.png)

**After Installing.**

![After Mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1cf081fb3fb8735d1832eb1bc1d117fb2130eb7a.png)

**Hover Message**

Stays the same and still works when clicking it making you leave the queue.
![Hover](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ucFn3csI/images/65f323997a2133ffbdcf164bb9ef6e44cdc528d0_350.webp)

**For 1.21+**

## INFO
**AS OF 2 DAYS AFTER UPLOADING THIS MOD, in invaded there was a /settings added to do the same thing, because I had told Blurmit the developer, to do this idea and integrate it into /settings, so now this mod is kinda useless but I'll leave it here either way but the /settings also a weird space line in between so yeah and MINE DOESN'T SO MIGHT BE THE ONLY REASON YOU USE THIS MOD.**
![Settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc47e93509019e17729b7c3c8d962b93b58c250a.png)

**_Made by Articuling aka xCheezie_**
